description: This source file defines a PHP class 'AboutOrganizationModel' which implements a data model for representing information about an organization within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides serialization of organization details, including company name, product name, version, and employee counts (accessible based on user role).

classes.name: AboutOrganizationModel
classes.description: A PHP class representing a REST API model for organization information, capable of normalizing data into an array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the model with an AboutOrganization object.

methods.name: getAboutOrganization
methods.description: Returns the AboutOrganization object associated with this model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the organization details into an array, including conditional inclusion of employee counts based on user role.
